# From Position C (rows 37-56, cols 6-23), go UP 8 times to reach top, then RIGHT to wrap
# Let me trace the path

def get_char_pos(seg):
    red_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] >= 50]
    if not red_nodes:
        return None
    all_rows, all_cols = [], []
    for n in red_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_rows.append(p[0])
            all_cols.append(p[1])

    red_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] >= 50]
